title: Live Lesson - Start Lesson is visible when Teaching Medium is Online
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) can be opened; Lesson teaching medium is Online.
steps_actions: 1. Open the BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Check the action area at the bottom of BO Calendar right panel.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Start Lesson button is visible.

title: Live Lesson - Start Lesson must NOT be visible when Teaching Medium is Offline
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) can be opened; Lesson teaching medium is Offline.
steps_actions: 1. Open the BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an offline lesson; 2. Check the action area at the bottom of BO Calendar right panel.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Start Lesson button must NOT be visible.

title: Live Lesson - Clicking Start Lesson opens live session and keeps BackOffice tab context
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson; Login session is valid and not expired.
steps_actions: 1. Open the BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Click Start Lesson; 3. Observe redirect behavior.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens and Start Lesson is shown; 2. Click action is executed successfully; 3. Live lesson session opens and BackOffice tab context is preserved.

title: Live Lesson - With valid SSO session the flow should NOT ask for login again after Start Lesson
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice with a valid session; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel); 2. Click Start Lesson; 3. Observe destination screen.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Redirect to live lesson is triggered; 3. System should NOT show login screen again.

title: Live Lesson - When live lesson service is unavailable the system shows error and must NOT lose current context
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson; Test environment can simulate service unavailable.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Click Start Lesson while service is unavailable; 3. Observe message and current screen state.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is sent; 3. System shows a proper error and must NOT lose BackOffice context.

title: Live Lesson - Student can join after teacher starts live lesson
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; Student is logged in to Learner App; Student is assigned to a valid online lesson; BO Calendar lesson detail panel shows Start Lesson for teacher.
steps_actions: 1. Teacher opens BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) in BackOffice; 2. Teacher clicks Start Lesson; 3. Student opens the same lesson in Learner App; 4. Student joins live lesson.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully for teacher; 2. Live lesson session is created successfully; 3. Learner App shows lesson as joinable; 4. Student joins successfully and should NOT receive permission error.

title: Live Lesson - URL uses new redirect format when ImproveSSO flag is ON
description: URL/Auth case for new redirect format.
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson; Feature flag User_Authentication_ImproveSSO is ON.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Click Start Lesson; 3. Observe opened redirect URL.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is executed successfully; 3. Redirect URL follows new format and data is valid by tenant rule.

title: Live Lesson - URL uses legacy format when ImproveSSO flag is OFF
description: URL/Auth case for legacy redirect format.
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson; Feature flag User_Authentication_ImproveSSO is OFF.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Click Start Lesson; 3. Observe opened redirect URL.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is executed successfully; 3. URL follows legacy format and should NOT use new redirect format.

title: Live Lesson - JPREP URL has correct structure and should NOT contain double slash
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson exists in JPREP tenant; Start Lesson is visible and clickable.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson in JPREP; 2. Click Start Lesson; 3. Observe redirect URL in destination tab.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is executed successfully; 3. URL matches JPREP structure and must NOT contain double slash in path.

title: Live Lesson - URL contains user_id parameter according to tenant rule
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson; Tenant requires user_id in redirect URL.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Click Start Lesson; 3. Observe query parameters in redirect URL.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is executed successfully; 3. URL contains user_id for teacher identity and must NOT be empty.

title: Live Lesson - With pop-up blocker enabled the system shows guidance or fallback
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson; Browser pop-up blocker is ON.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Click Start Lesson while pop-up blocker is ON; 3. Observe guidance message or fallback behavior.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is executed; 3. System shows guidance/fallback as designed and must NOT crash/show blank screen.
